name: Skin of Sweet Rum
summary: At the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, Skin of Sweet Rum is bound for Lakeshire, where war has thinned the tavern's stores.

sections.title: A Rare Comfort for Lakeshire
sections.body: Lakeshire's tavern supplies are running low as the Blackrock orc invasion cuts off the roads into the Redridge Mountains. Barkeep Daniels needs drink for the town guards and refugees, so he sends travelers to gather regional specialties. Among them is a waterskin of sweet rum from the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.

faq.q: Where can I find a Skin of Sweet Rum?
faq.answer: You can buy a Skin of Sweet Rum from the innkeeper or barkeep at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, in Elwynn Forest.
Barkeep Daniels, who keeps the tavern in Lakeshire, wants a skin of Sweet Rum and other regional brews to refill his shelves during Dry Times.

faq.q: Why is Lakeshire running out of liquor?
aliases: why are they out of booze
faq.answer: The Blackrock orc invasion has cut trade routes into Redridge, leaving merchant wagons unable to travel safely and Lakeshire's liquor stocks nearly empty.

faq.q: What other spirits are needed alongside the rum?
faq.answer: Barkeep Daniels also needs a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Westfall, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind City, and a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, gathering the rum shows the strain the Blackrock orc invasion puts on the small settlements defending Stormwind's eastern borders.
